resources.string: Florilegium keeps the lines you want to keep. One archive, synced to phone, tablet and desktop from a single Compose Multiplatform codebase.
The Daily tab draws a fresh page at dawn — one quote of the day set large, nine more beneath it. Pull the list down whenever you want another draw.
Everything you have ever saved lives in All quotes. The search button lifts a field into the app bar; type an author or a phrase and the list narrows as you go.
Made for both hands and both screens
Bottom navigation on a phone, a navigation rail and a two-pane reader on a tablet in landscape. Light and dark schemes follow the system.
